implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory run on the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter using the hosted GPT-5-mini model (gpt-5-mini). For each of the 160 tasks: (1) issue a single shared initial generation call (1 model call) producing the candidate configuration used by both conditions; (2) in the guarded condition allow at most one deterministic repair-generation call (at most 1 additional model call) if the deterministic validator rejects the initial candidate. All validation, simulation enactment, scoring, exclusion rules, hashing, fuzzy-similarity screening, retries (up to 2 automatic retries on transient API failure), and exclusion logging implemented using adapter-hosted deterministic scorers and local CPU dockerized simulator. No human labour is used. Total maximum model calls = task_count * 2 = 320. Estimated calls assume ~50% of tasks require a guarded repair -> 160 + 80 = 240.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic ingest of public corpora and seeded synthetic augmentations; exact snapshot scripts and SHA-256 input hashes published with artifacts.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic template instantiation and canonicalizer/parser unit-tested with pre-registered regression vectors; automatic exclusion rules applied when parser/canonicalizer fails semantic-preservation checks.
randomisation_plan: Task selection and augmentation are deterministic from published seeds; within each batch tasks are executed in fixed order to preserve reproducibility.
caching_plan: Cache model API responses per prompt hash; reuse cached initial-generation when identical prompt hash detected (duplicates auto-excluded per preregistration).
failure_recovery_plan: Automatic retry up to 2 times for transient provider errors; persistent API failure for a task-method-seed marks technical failure and task is re-scheduled within model-call budget; simulator regression-test failures abort run and trigger automated re-run after regression fixes (logged).
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-task binary actionable misconfiguration labels for baseline and guarded episodes, validator-block flags, simulator traces, canonicalized configuration ASTs, prompt and response hashes).
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call budget: estimated_model_calls=240 (derivation: 160 tasks × 1 initial call + estimated 80 guarded repair calls). Maximum_model_calls=320 (derivation: 160 tasks × (1 initial + 1 repair) = 320). All model calls use hosted API (gpt-5-mini) per adapter; simulator runs executed in local docker (CPU) within adapter contract. Total model calls well below capability manifest limit (10000). Wall-clock within 7 days given hosted API throughput and batched simulator runs.
